# 1on1 Devon - 2026-10-07

**Time:** 45 min, Wednesday 9 AM
**Person:** [[Devon Park]]

## What Devon brought up

**Reconciliation fix is in review.** The position model now consumes DriveWealth corporate-action events directly instead of deriving split ratios ourselves. Backfill for the 0.4% of affected positions is written and tested against a copy of production. Marcus and one more reviewer have it. He's confident on Oct 14. He'll write a rollout plan (flagged, backfill first, reconcile, then enable) so go/no-go #2 has something concrete to look at.

**ADR-032.** The draft for moving the round-up sweep onto the outbox pipeline went up today. He wants to lead the build. Marcus is fine with it. I'm more than fine with it.

**Staff, again.** He brought it up himself. Pointed out, without bragging, that his reconciliation alert caught Sep 26 in 47 minutes. He asked whether that counts. Yes. It's exactly the cross-system impact I described in [[1on1 Devon - 2026-09-17]].

## What I brought up

**The Sidekiq ACH code.** Still not deleted. Approved on Sep 17. He's been on recon, which was the right priority, and he said so before I could. But dead money-moving code that anyone can re-enable with a config change is how we got Sep 26 on a different job. It goes by Oct 16, after the recon fix is merged.

Decision: recon fix first; Sidekiq ACH deletion immediately after, no later than Oct 16.

**The staff case.** Told him I'm writing it down with Marcus this month. Three pillars: reconciliation as a company-wide standard, ADR-032 as the cross-system build, and Sarah's ramp as the mentorship evidence. He went quiet, then said thanks. I could tell it mattered more than the words.

## Commitments

- [ ] Devon: reconciliation fix through review by 2026-10-14
- [ ] Devon: reconciliation fix rollout plan before go/no-go #2 by 2026-10-14
- [ ] Devon: delete Sidekiq ACH code by 2026-10-16
- [ ] Me: write down Devon's staff case with Marcus by 2026-10-23

## Read on Devon

The engineer I was most worried about losing in May is now the one asking for the hardest work. Retention through ownership. The comp still has to land after close, though.

Related: [[Investing Launch]], [[ACH Pipeline]], [[Marcus Bell]].
